items.title: 7.3 Factors affecting rate of a chemical reaction (reaction ki rate par asar karne wale factors) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.3, printed page 150.

blocks.text: Aam taur par reactions mein reactants ke kharch hone aur products ke banne ki rates mein bohat farq hota hai. Ek hi reactants wali reaction bhi alag conditions (halaat) mein alag rate se chal sakti hai. Reaction ki rate par asar karne wale factors yeh hain:

items: Surface area (bahar ki satah kitni bari hai)

blocks.caption: Chaar factors ek nazar mein
rows: Concentration barhe to rate barhti hai
Barhti hai; har 10 °C par taqreeban dugni
Tez aur zyada energy wale collisions; zyada molecules Eₐ se upar
Solid ka surface area barhe to rate barhti hai
Collision ke liye zyada particles samne aate hain
Kam activation energy wala naya rasta

blocks.prompt: Lakri pure (khalis) oxygen mein hawa se tez kyun jalti hai, aur lakri ke chhote tukre (chhilke) bare kunde se tez kyun jalte hain?
blocks.explanation: Hawa mein sirf taqreeban panchwan hissa oxygen hai; pure oxygen mein oxygen ki concentration zyada hai, is liye zyada collisions aur tez reaction. Chhote tukron ka surface area usi wazan ke kunde se kahin zyada hai, is liye ek waqt mein zyada collisions ho sakte hain.

items: Rate concentration, temperature, surface area aur catalyst par depend karti hai; detail (tafseel) 7.3.1 se 7.3.3 mein hai.
